messages:
nina: quick heads-up 3 — opening a tiny docs PR to align SDK snippets for streaming, pagination tokens, and retries across py/ts/go. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4510

harry: thanks. exact renames so I can patch TS: `page_token` -> `cursor_token`, response `next_cursor` replaces `cursor`, `retry_policy` -> `retries` (shape { attempts, backoff_ms? }).

maria: streaming shape change noted: Python/TS provide async iterators, Go uses stream.Next(ctx) pull loop. keep quickstart examples compact and link to examples/ for full patterns.

nina: proposed quickstart snippets (compact):

Python:
```python
async for part in client.stream.generate(model="rwd-1-stream", prompt=prompt, retries={"attempts":2}):
    print(part.text, end="")
```

TypeScript:
```ts
for await (const part of client.stream.generate({ model: "rwd-1-stream", prompt, retries: { attempts: 3 } })) {
  process.stdout.write(part.text)
}
```

Go (compact):
```go
stream, _ := client.StreamGenerate(ctx, req)
defer stream.Close()
for {
  tok, err := stream.Next(ctx)
  if err == io.EOF { break }
  if err != nil { log.Printf("stream error: %v", err); break }
  fmt.Print(tok.Text)
}
```

maria: add one-liners: catch StreamError in Python and fallback to sync.generate; buffer partial tokens if you need sentence-level output; mark quantized variants in model table that streaming latency may vary.
